command:
set -eu
repo=$1; github=$2; base=$3; pr=$4; ticket=$5; head=$6; headref=$7; merge=$8; root=$9
block() ( kind=$1; reason=$2; factory linear state "$ticket" Blocked --add ai:blocked --remove ai:needs-review || true; factory linear comment "$ticket" "$kind after merge $merge: $reason. Branch/worktree preserved; merge barrier remains held." || true; factory notify "$kind $ticket/PR#$pr: $reason" || true; exit 1; )
pr_state=$(gh pr view "$pr" --repo "$github" --json state --jq .state)
merge_sha=$(gh pr view "$pr" --repo "$github" --json mergeCommit --jq .mergeCommit.oid)
[ "$pr_state" = MERGED ] && [ "$merge_sha" = "$merge" ] || ( echo "landed PR no longer proves exact merge commit" >&2; exit 1 )
gate=$(ROOT=$root REPO=$repo bun -e 'const p=process.env; const m=await import("file://"+p.ROOT+"/event-runtime/lib/repos.mjs"); const r=m.getRepo(m.loadRepos(Object.fromEntries([["root",p.ROOT]])),p.REPO); if(!r.mergeCi)process.exit(2); process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(r.mergeCi))') || ( echo "merge_ci workflow/check gate is unavailable" >&2; exit 1 )
workflow=$(printf '%s' "$gate" | jq -r .workflow)
expected=$(printf '%s' "$gate" | jq -c .requiredChecks)
ci_ok=false
for i in $(seq 1 90); do
  runs=$(gh run list --repo "$github" --workflow "$workflow" --event push --branch "$base" --commit "$merge" --limit 20 --json databaseId,status,conclusion,headSha,workflowName)
  matching=$(printf '%s' "$runs" | jq -c --arg workflow "$workflow" --arg sha "$merge" '[.[] | select(.workflowName == $workflow and .headSha == $sha)]')
  run_count=$(printf '%s' "$matching" | jq length)
  [ "$run_count" -le 1 ] || block "CI RED" "configured $workflow workflow is ambiguous at exact merge SHA"
  if [ "$run_count" -eq 1 ]; then
    run_id=$(printf '%s' "$matching" | jq -r '.[0].databaseId')
    jobs=$(gh run view "$run_id" --repo "$github" --json jobs --jq .jobs)
    duplicate=$(printf '%s' "$jobs" | jq -r --argjson expected "$expected" '. as $jobs | any($expected[]; . as $name | [$jobs[] | select(.name == $name)] | length > 1)')
    [ "$duplicate" = false ] || block "CI RED" "configured $workflow jobs are ambiguous at exact merge SHA"
    present=$(printf '%s' "$jobs" | jq -r --argjson expected "$expected" '. as $jobs | all($expected[]; . as $name | [$jobs[] | select(.name == $name)] | length == 1)')
    if [ "$present" = true ]; then
      failed=$(printf '%s' "$jobs" | jq -r --argjson expected "$expected" '. as $jobs | any($expected[]; . as $name | [$jobs[] | select(.name == $name)][0] | .status == "completed" and .conclusion != "success")')
      [ "$failed" = false ] || block "CI RED" "configured $workflow workflow failed at exact merge SHA"
      if printf '%s' "$jobs" | jq -e --argjson expected "$expected" '. as $jobs | all($expected[]; . as $name | [$jobs[] | select(.name == $name)][0] | .status == "completed" and .conclusion == "success")' >/dev/null; then
        ci_ok=true; break
      fi
    fi
  fi
  sleep 10
done
[ "$ci_ok" = true ] || block "CI RED" "configured $workflow workflow and required jobs did not settle at exact merge SHA"
smoke=$(ROOT=$root REPO=$repo bun -e 'import fs from "node:fs"; const y=Bun.YAML.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.env.ROOT+"/config/repos.yaml","utf8")); const r=y.repos.find(x=>x.name===process.env.REPO); if(!r)process.exit(2); process.stdout.write(r.smoke_workflow??"")')
if [ -n "$smoke" ]; then
  smoke_ok=false
  for i in $(seq 1 90); do
    sruns=$(gh run list --repo "$github" --workflow "$smoke" --branch "$base" --commit "$merge" --limit 20 --json databaseId,status,conclusion)
    n=$(printf '%s' "$sruns" | jq length)
    if [ "$n" -gt 0 ] && printf '%s' "$sruns" | jq -e 'all(.[]; .status == "completed")' >/dev/null; then
      printf '%s' "$sruns" | jq -e 'all(.[]; .conclusion == "success" or .conclusion == "neutral" or .conclusion == "skipped")' >/dev/null || block "SMOKE RED" "configured smoke workflow $smoke failed at $merge"
      smoke_ok=true; break
    fi
    sleep 10
  done
  [ "$smoke_ok" = true ] || block "SMOKE RED" "configured smoke workflow $smoke did not settle at $merge"
fi
cleanup=false
ref_error=$(mktemp)
if remote=$(gh api "repos/$github/git/ref/heads/$headref" --jq .object.sha 2>"$ref_error"); then
  [ "$remote" = "$head" ] || ( echo "head branch moved; refusing cleanup" >&2; exit 1 )
  set +e
  FACTORY_BRANCH_GUARD_REPOS_YAML="$root/config/repos.yaml" factory branch-guard --repo "$repo" --pr "$pr" --head "$headref"
  guard_status=$?
  set -e
  if [ "$guard_status" -eq 0 ]; then cleanup=true; elif [ "$guard_status" -eq 2 ]; then echo "branch/worktree cleanup preserved by branch guard" >&2; else echo "branch cleanup guard could not evaluate" >&2; exit 1; fi
elif rg -q 'HTTP 404' "$ref_error"; then
  : # exact prior cleanup is idempotent
else
  cat "$ref_error" >&2; exit 1
fi
rm -f "$ref_error"
if [ "$cleanup" = true ]; then
  ROOT=$root REPO=$repo TICKET=$ticket bun -e 'import fs from "node:fs"; import childProcess from "node:child_process"; import path from "node:path"; const y=Bun.YAML.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.env.ROOT+"/config/repos.yaml","utf8")); const r=y.repos.find(x=>x.name===process.env.REPO); if(!r||!r.worktree_down||!r.worktree_root||!r.path)process.exit(2); const p=path.join(r.worktree_root.replace(/^~(?=\/)/,process.env.HOME),process.env.TICKET); const q=fs.existsSync(p)&&childProcess.spawnSync("/bin/bash",[r.worktree_down,process.env.TICKET],Object.fromEntries([["cwd",r.path.replace(/^~(?=\/)/,process.env.HOME)],["stdio","inherit"]])); q&&process.exit(q.status??1)'
  gh api -X DELETE "repos/$github/git/refs/heads/$headref"
fi
factory linear state "$ticket" Done --remove ai:needs-review --remove ai:escalated --remove ai:blocked --remove ai:in-progress
REPO=$repo MERGE=$merge ROOT=$root bun -e 'const p=process.env; const dbModule=await import("file://"+p.ROOT+"/event-runtime/lib/db.mjs"); const chainModule=await import("file://"+p.ROOT+"/event-runtime/lib/chain.mjs"); const registryModule=await import("file://"+p.ROOT+"/event-runtime/lib/registry.mjs"); const db=dbModule.openDb(); const rows=db.query(`SELECT run_id FROM runs WHERE state = "RUNNING" AND json_extract(spec_json, "$.agent") = "merge-verify@1" AND json_extract(spec_json, "$.input.mergeCommitSha") = ?`).all(p.MERGE); if(rows.length!==1) throw new Error("expected one running merge verifier, found "+rows.length); const eventId="merge-next:"+p.REPO+":"+p.MERGE; const outcome=chainModule.admitChainEvent(db,registryModule.loadRegistry(),Object.fromEntries([["schemaVersion","factory.event/v1"],["eventId",eventId],["type","factory.merge.requested"],["subject",p.REPO],["occurredAt",new Date().toISOString()],["correlationId",eventId],["causationId",rows[0].run_id],["payload",Object.fromEntries([["repo",p.REPO]])]])); db.close(); if(!outcome.admitted&&!outcome.duplicate) throw new Error(outcome.errors.join("; "));'
